tool_signatures.name: save_memory
tool_signatures.description: Create or supersede an atomic memory (<= 25 words) in SQLite and synchronize Markdown scope exports.

content.description: Atomic memory statement. STRICT LIMIT: MUST be <= 25 words. Omit filler words.

subject.description: Deterministic slot key (e.g., 'app-port', 'db-stack'). Saving with an existing (scope, subject) automatically supersedes the old fact.

anchor_files.description: Repo-relative file paths (e.g., ['docker-compose.yml']). Git commits touching these files auto-flag this memory as [STALE].

replaces_id.description: Optional explicit memory ID to supersede.
